Ride Like the Wind.quote: The only record with 'Yacht House' in its own title, released under Cross's name. This is where the tag comes from.

What You Won't Do for Love.quote: Keeps 13 of the 17 lines, with a voice on for 43% of the track. The second verse is cut, and 'and I can't let go' goes round six times at 1:33. You can still sing along.

What a Fool Believes.quote: The genre's founding text. If a yacht house list doesn't open the door with McDonald, it isn't one.

Lowdown.quote: First track on Yacht House Summer Vol 1. The tag starts here.

I Keep Forgettin'.quote: Warren G and Nate Dogg built 'Regulate' on this hook in 1994, and Party Pupils' live sets mash the two together. A remix that knows the song's whole history.

Long Train Runnin'.quote: A 1993 house remix took it to number 7 in the UK, twenty years after the original. Yacht house before anyone called it that.

Lotta Love.quote: Joey Negro has re-edited disco since the 80s, and he named it a yacht mix himself.

Peg.quote: Steely Dan is the hardest band to remix without losing the point. Vol 1 tries, and the panel wants to hear it before it stays.

I Can't Go for That.quote: A Roland CompuRhythm loop to start with. It was always a dance record waiting.

How Long.quote: Keeps 11 of 14 lines, nearly in the original's order, and the voice is on for 58% of the track at almost the same tempo. Closer to an extended edit than a flip, and the easiest one here to sing along to.

Reminiscing.quote: About 94 up to 109 BPM, and the voice is on for under a third of the track. It's a groove record with Glenn Shorrock dropping in, which is what a DJ wants.

Biggest Part of Me.quote: The one Party Pupils remix that really cuts the song up. It uses 13 of the 53 lines and ad-libs, jumps back through the original nine times, and sings for under a third of the track.

Steal Away.quote: Already on our Yacht Rock list, and on Vol 2 of Party Pupils' own canon.

Brandy.quote: Vol 1, next to Lowdown and Peg. 1972 is early, but our Yacht Rock list already took it.

Baby Come Back.quote: With Mayer Hawthorne on it. The one remix here with a guest from the 2010s soul revival.

Turn Your Love Around.quote: Jay Graydon, Steve Lukather and Bill Champlin wrote it, so it's yacht royalty, and it's on Vol 3 and on the tag's Spotify list.

Georgy Porgy.quote: Toto's most dance-floor groove, with Cheryl Lynn on the chorus. Vol 2.
